title: Pregnant Duo #27
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Filipina, in her early 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, long voluminous chestnut waves, a bright, confident pageant smile, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 200 studs piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a ring. Painted in French Limoges enamel, a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of grisaille scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: French, in her early 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her hips and rear so wide. A high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly projects forward prominently from her front, while behind it a rear so massively rounded and projecting dominates from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape, echoing the belly's own roundness from the opposite side. A full round bust above the belly, gigantic thick thighs. Her head looks small on top of her body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, long dark-brown hair in an effortless tousled updo, an unbothered, effortless expression, wavy hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 bars piercings set with diamonds in gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver a necklace. Painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern, a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of geometric star-and-polygon tile wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
